names.en: Gruel Mud Immortal Gu remnant recipe

summary.text: The remnant recipe for Gruel Mud Immortal Gu, a one-time consumable that treasure yellow heaven values above the worm itself. Fang Yuan trades corroded mud for pieces of the recipe, then works to deduce those pieces into a complete copy.

claims.text: Several Gu Immortals ask Little Hu Immortal for the price of gruel mud the moment she opens connecting heaven Gu in treasure yellow heaven. One admits he lacks the Gruel Mud Immortal Gu’s recipe and so has no use for the mud itself. Fang Yuan will not take immortal essence stones for it, and when bidders protest that a pile of mud cannot be worth an Immortal Gu’s recipe, Little Hu Immortal answers that whoever holds the remnant recipe with the highest treasure light will win the trade.

Gu Immortals bringing damaged remnant recipes worth less than ten feet of treasure light soon return with copies reaching thirty to forty feet. None of the gruel mud recipes on offer satisfy Fang Yuan, so he keeps selling mud and keeps refusing every trade.

Immortal Mudfeet offers a remnant recipe with sixty five feet of treasure light, lower than rival bids, and closes the gap with ten thousand hairy men. Fang Yuan rejects an all young batch as too weak for refinement work, and after haggling Immortal Mudfeet sells over three thousand old hairy men and over seven thousand young ones for the recipe plus half an immortal essence stone. The recipe holds only sixty percent of its contents, tampered with many times over, so Fang Yuan still has to sort the true lines from the false ones, but he treats the damaged copy as a foundation for deducing the complete recipe later.

Another batch of gruel mud sold in treasure yellow heaven earns Fang Yuan a further remnant recipe of Gruel Mud Immortal Gu. The remnant recipes he sold earlier get resold again by Little Hu Immortal after a gap of time, this round for eleven immortal essence stones, though repeated sales drop a recipe’s treasure light and make the method a poor long term income.

Fang Yuan activates the rank six Immortal Gu Delight in Water and Mountain to feed the light of wisdom, and in a dozen breaths advances the deduction of the gruel mud recipe by one percent, progress that would otherwise cost him half a year alone. The base he works from is a sixty percent remnant recipe collated from the copies he traded for, and completing a rank six Immortal Gu recipe from nothing would cost over a hundred beads of green grape immortal essence. Fang Yuan calls the gruel mud remnant recipe their most promising lead, but finishing it will still take about forty beads of immortal essence, more than he and Tai Bai Yun Sheng can safely spend while northern plains Gu Immortals hunt for them.

Refinement materials.text: mud carrying Gruel Mud Immortal Gu's power, cleared from Dang Hun Mountain

Source.text: remnant recipes bought from Gu Immortals in treasure yellow heaven, each tampered with by its seller before sale
